name: Proposal for a decision
title: REPORT on the request for the waiver of the immunity of Alessandra Moretti
part_text:
The European Parliament has decided to lift the legal protection that Alessandra Moretti, a Member of the European Parliament from Italy, holds as an elected representative. Belgian prosecutors want to charge her with taking part in a criminal organisation and taking bribes, linked to the Qatar corruption investigation. The vote means Belgium can now pursue its case against her in court. Parliament found no sign that the case was brought to damage her political work.

- **What changes:** Moretti loses her protection from prosecution in Belgium, so the criminal case can go ahead.
- **Who it affects:** Alessandra Moretti, a Member of the European Parliament elected in Italy.
- **What happens next:** Parliament's President sends the decision to the Belgian authorities and to Moretti.
